about: Representative requests that do not name a skill. `profiles`: acceptable routing profiles, the first one primary. `skills`: acceptable catalog skills, any one of them counts. `specialist`: a Research Agent Skills specialist reached through the research index. `cues`: wording of the primary profile's routing description that should match the request. tests/routing-skills.test.mjs checks this metadata structurally; experiments/routing-selection measures what a real model reads. Requests with `heldOut: true` were written after the first measurement round and were not used to tune the routing text; they carry no cues. Requests with `round: 2` were added for the second measurement round (index path, sample-size wrapper and diagram evaluation) and were not used to tune any routing text. A request without acceptable `skills` is a negative case: it lists `avoidSkills` that should not be opened. `scenario` names an entry of `scenarios` (default `readonly`): the tools, working-directory fixture, browser and limits of experiments/routing-selection/run.mjs.
